title: Higher Order Convergence for the Sharp Interface Limit of 3D Navier--Stokes/Allen--Cahn Systems
summary: We show convergence of solutions to a Navier--Stokes/Allen--Cahn system as the interfacial thickness $\varepsilon>0$ tends to zero for well-prepared initial data as long as the limit system possesses a sufficiently smooth solution. The limit system consists of a two-phase Navier--Stokes system separated by a sharp interface in the presence of surface tension coupled to a convective mean curvature flow equation.
